论据”。
persuade sb. to do sth.：说服某人干某事
words.definition: 说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事
words.etymology: 14世纪后期，“action of inducing (someone) to believe (something);
examples:
To persuade the government to change its current economic policies.
说服政府去改变现行的经济政策。
words.mnemonic: per-（彻底）+ -suad（=to urge：力劝）+ -e→彻底劝说→说服；劝

collocations: persuasive salesmanship：有说服力的推销术
words.definition: 有说服力的；令人信服的
words.mnemonic: persuas（=persuade：说服；使相信）+ -ive（形容词后缀）→有说服

collocations: great powers of persuasion：极强的说服力
words.definition: 说服，劝说；（宗教或政治）信仰，信念
words.mnemonic: persuas（=persuade：说服；使相信）+-ion（名词后缀）→说服，劝
